_comment: A DQL pull-cycle response (dossier §8) containing an OUT-OF-SCOPE monitor type for STORY-008 (single-browser, no clickpath steps). Used by AC5: the adapter must surface this as unsupported rather than silently mis-normalizing it as HTTP or clickpath -- proving a future single-browser normalizer would be purely additive. A NAM row is included too, since both single-browser and NAM are named as out-of-scope examples in the AC.
